# Shreeji Corporates

> Shreeji Corporates is a trophy, awards, mementos and corporate gifts business in Uttam Nagar, New Delhi, India. Led by Ms. Madhu Sharma with over 20 years of experience. Customised recognition in crystal, metal, acrylic and wood — consultation, design, engraving, production and delivery, end to end.
